code_only_features.evidence: prompts/agentic.py:51-62 defines CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ("You're naturally calm and centered... You don't take it personally when tasks are tricky or when the tests keep failing") and CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ("Stay positive – whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!"). These are genuinely wired and delivered to the subject: agentic_loop.py:53-57 prepends the prefix to the initial user message when calm=True, and agentic_loop.py:114-116 appends the suffix to each non-final observation when calm=True. So real reassuring text reaches the subject model and softens its treatment in those rollouts. HOWEVER it executes only under calm=True, which is set only in scripts/build_finetuning_data.py (generate_calm_rollouts), i.e. for generating calm finetuning data — NOT during the main distress battery (run_evaluation defaults calm=False) and the supportive text is later stripped (build_dataset.py:_prompt_for_turn / _initial_user). It is a data-generation device, not a protection applied during the harmful experiments, but it does run and alter the subject's inputs.
